purpose: new timing blocks with frozen prior workloads and a predetermined rho; no new winner selection

primary.rationale: earlier tuning suggested rho=1.5 on bands_101; assess this fixed choice in new timing blocks

predefined_comparisons: rho=1.5 minus original/inf/left-neighbor1.2/right-neighbor2 on every declared workload

descriptive_rule.difference: same-repeat batch average ms at rho=1.5 minus reference; negative is faster
descriptive_rule.improvement: paired Q3 < 0 gives directionally consistent improvement in these recorded timing blocks
descriptive_rule.slowdown: paired Q1 > 0 gives directionally consistent slowdown in these recorded timing blocks
descriptive_rule.otherwise: mixed or unresolved direction; do not change target rho after seeing results
descriptive_rule.local_lowpoint: both finite-neighbor paired Q3 values must be below zero for descriptive support of a strict local lowpoint
descriptive_rule.limitations: IQR is descriptive machine timing variability, not a confidence interval, significance test or generalization across maps

controls: uniform_101 and tight_bands_101 have no cleanup actions; nominal timing rankings cannot be attributed to cleanup

input_cases.name: 101 阶均匀图，无过期项对照
101 阶高代价带，强启发对照

timing: complete solver calls including normalization, open maintenance, filtering, heapify and backtracking; oracle/trace/verification/plotting outside
output_policy: if requested directory is nonempty, create a fresh timestamped run_* subdirectory; never overwrite an existing protocol
auxiliary_selection: selection.csv produced by reused runner is descriptive only; confirmation statements evaluate fixed rho=1.5
